clue.text: Lover of sport upset after a game's end

indicators.note: after places the turned piece behind the game's-end piece in the answer

parts.note: mate is how a game of chess ends

indicators.note: upset, in a down-to-up or turned-over sense, signals the sport's letters running backwards

parts.note: RU is short for Rugby Union, a sport

explanation.surface: A sports fan gets upset once the match is over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lover of sport' looks like the whole definition, a fan; only 'Lover' defines, from Latin amator. 'upset' turns the sport's letters around.
explanation.definitionFit: The word comes from Latin amator, a lover, and still means one who does a thing for love rather than pay.

clue.text: Weigh Jenny?

definitions.meaning: to weigh up is to evaluate
a jenny is a female donkey; the female of an ass, by the suffix -ess as in lioness

explanation.definitionFit: To weigh up is to evaluate; and split as ass plus -ess it is a female donkey, which a jenny is.

clue.text: Car included in some severance pay

indicators.note: included in places the car word within the some word

parts.note: any means some, as in 'have you any?'
a limo, limousine, is a car

explanation.surface: A company car was part of a redundancy package.
explanation.walkthrough: 'severance pay' means what a court orders after a divorce, not a redundancy payout.
explanation.definitionFit: Alimony is maintenance paid after a marriage is severed by divorce.

clue.text: Bound to pray when going round church

indicators.note: when going round says the pray word encloses the church abbreviation

parts.note: to entreat is to pray, beg

explanation.surface: A worshipper bound to pray while walking round a church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bound' looks like 'obliged', but it is a leap.
explanation.definitionFit: An entrechat is a ballet leap in which the dancer crosses the feet in the air, a bound.

clue.text: You'll find Harris in one, shivering, whatever the weather

indicators.note: shivering, shaking about, signals the letters of Harris in one are jumbled

explanation.surface: In Harris tweed you won't shiver, whatever the weather.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shivering' rearranges HARRISINONE. Harris is a Scottish island famed for its tweed.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means regardless of the weather, in all conditions.

clue.text: Exponents of popular games

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
to dice is to play games with dice, so dices means games, plays at dice

explanation.surface: Champions of well-liked pastimes are being described.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Exponents' looks like people who champion games, but it is the mathematical sense.
explanation.definitionFit: In mathematics the small raised power numbers are called exponents or indices.

clue.text: Swimmer examined orally

indicators.note: orally, spoken by mouth, says the examined word is said aloud

parts.note: to have eyed something is to have examined it

explanation.surface: A swimmer had a spoken examination.
explanation.definitionFit: The ide is a freshwater fish of the carp family, a swimmer.

clue.text: Took out old hat

definitions.meaning: took out, as in went on a date with someone
old hat means outmoded, no longer fashionable

explanation.definitionFit: Dating someone is taking them out; something no longer fashionable has become stale.

clue.text: To which an estate may be entrusted for safe-keeping

definitions.text: To which an estate may be entrusted for safe-keeping

parts.words: To which an estate may be entrusted for safe-keeping
parts.note: reads like a bank holding a dead person's property, but the estate is an estate car left where vehicles are kept

explanation.definitionFit: An estate car is a vehicle, and such a place is where drivers leave vehicles.

clue.text: Provide information on offence ultimately meriting prison

parts.note: to sing is slang for informing to the police
a sin is an offence

indicators.note: ultimately takes the final letter of meriting

explanation.surface: An informer's tip on a crime ends up deserving jail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' is a link. SING SING is a famous New York state prison.
explanation.definitionFit: Sing Sing is a maximum-security jail at Ossining, New York.

clue.text: Very good casting in talkies

indicators.note: casting, as in moulding into a new form, tells us to rearrange the letters of in talkies

explanation.surface: Someone was superb in the casting of talking pictures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'casting' rearranges INTALKIES.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone like a saint is extremely virtuous, very good in the moral sense.

clue.text: I go round city

indicators.note: round says the go word goes round the letter I, enclosing it

parts.note: a go is a turn, as in 'whose go is it?'

explanation.surface: A traveller says they will make a tour of a city.
explanation.definitionFit: Turin is a major city in northern Italy, capital of Piedmont.

clue.text: Record number

definitions.meaning: to record, as in keeping a tally of points

explanation.definitionFit: A score can be a written musical record or a tally, and also the quantity twenty.

clue.text: Islanders have nothing for leader of countrymen

indicators.note: for leader of says the first letter of the countrymen word is swapped for something else

parts.note: Arcadians are idealised rustics, country folk of pastoral Arcadia
O, the zero shape, means nothing

explanation.surface: Some islanders have no time for the head of a rural community.
explanation.walkthrough: 'have' is a link: O replaces the leading A of ARCADIANS.
explanation.definitionFit: Orcadians are natives of Orkney, the island group off northern Scotland.

clue.text: He describes how French upset ecclesiastical tribunal

parts.note: comment is the French word for how

indicators.note: upset, in a down clue, signals that the tribunal's letters are turned upwards

parts.note: the Rota is the Roman Catholic Church's court of appeal

explanation.surface: Someone explains how the French were annoyed by a church court.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns ROTA into ATOR.
explanation.definitionFit: A sports reporter or broadcaster who narrates events is someone who describes them.

clue.text: Enemy takes both manoeuvres simultaneously

indicators.note: manoeuvres, military movements, signals that the letters of Enemy takes both are moved about

explanation.surface: A foe captures two positions in one military operation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'manoeuvres' rearranges ENEMYTAKESBOTH.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is used for 'equally, at the same time or for the same reason', loosely matching simultaneously.

clue.text: Xanthippe — name given to a monster without one?

parts.note: a term is a name for something

indicators.note: without signals the one letter is removed from the monster word

parts.note: a giant is a monster
I, the Roman numeral, means one

explanation.surface: A shrewish wife is labelled a monster lacking a heart.
explanation.walkthrough: Xanthippe was Socrates's wife, a byword for a scold. 'given to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A termagant is a scolding, shrewish woman, which Socrates's wife proverbially was.

clue.text: Stone frigate

definitions.meaning: HMS ..., the Royal Navy frigate of the 1949 Yangtze Incident

explanation.definitionFit: It is a violet gem, and the name of a famous British warship.

clue.text: Change ruining one team sport

indicators.note: Change, as an instruction, tells us to rearrange the letters of ruining one team

explanation.surface: A substitution wrecks a side playing some sport.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Change' rearranges RUININGONETEAM.
explanation.definitionFit: Climbing peaks is an outdoor sport.

clue.text: Superior sage put in a stew

indicators.note: in a stew, meaning in a muddle, signals the letters of sage put are mixed up

explanation.surface: A lofty herb is added to a casserole.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sage' looks like a herb or a wise man; with 'put' it is fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means haughty, snobbish, behaving as if superior.

clue.text: Careless, dropping book's wrapper

indicators.note: dropping says the book letters fall out of the careless word

parts.note: negligent means careless
NT, the New Testament, is a book of the Bible

explanation.surface: Someone careless lost a book's dust jacket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Careless' looks like the definition but is the word cut down; the definition is 'wrapper'.
explanation.definitionFit: A negligee is a loose gown, a garment one wraps around oneself.

clue.text: Junket needs some money raised

indicators.note: raised, in a down clue, says the money word reads from bottom to top

parts.note: a tenner is a ten-pound note, some money

explanation.surface: A jaunt needs some cash raised.
explanation.walkthrough: Junket here is a sweet milk pudding, not a trip; it is set with rennet.
explanation.definitionFit: Curdling milk for the dessert called junket requires an enzyme extract from a calf's stomach.

clue.text: Will try getting last word before end of argument

parts.note: to try something is to test it
amen is the word that ends a prayer

indicators.note: end of picks out the final letter of argument

explanation.surface: A testator tries to have the final say before a dispute ends.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Will' looks like a verb of intent, but it is the legal document; 'getting' and 'before' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: A will, as in 'last will and testament', is the legal document setting out a person's bequests.

clue.text: Miss Wickfield collects silver coins up

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

indicators.note: up, in a down clue, says the coins word reads upwards

parts.note: sen are small coins of Japan and elsewhere

explanation.surface: A young lady gathers up silver coins.
explanation.walkthrough: Agnes Wickfield is the heroine of Dickens's David Copperfield. 'collects' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Agnes Wickfield is the daughter of Copperfield's lawyer, and his second wife.

clue.text: Fish's head coming out of seaweed

indicators.note: head coming out of says the first letter of the seaweed word is removed

parts.note: tangle is a type of large brown seaweed, kelp

explanation.surface: A fish pokes its head out from among the seaweed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fish's' is 'Fish is': the definition then a link. TANGLE is a name for kelp.
explanation.definitionFit: To angle is to fish with rod and line.

clue.text: Long time getting to the point

parts.note: a year is a period of time
N, north, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: It takes a long time to come to the point.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To long for something is to yearn, to want it badly.

clue.text: A lot of men take retaliation on club

indicators.note: on, as in 'placed on top of', puts the retaliation word after the club word

parts.note: a bat is a club for hitting a ball
talion is the law of retaliation, an eye for an eye

explanation.surface: Many men seek revenge with a club.
explanation.walkthrough: Talion, as in lex talionis, is an old word for retaliation in kind; 'take' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A battalion is a large army unit, many hundreds of soldiers.

clue.text: Battle order put out by saint

annotationWithheld.why: Battle order put out by saint (3): BEN; seemingly Benedictine (Battle Abbey's order, founded by St Benedict) abbreviated, but no sound parse for the three letters was found
annotationWithheld.clue: Battle order put out by saint

clue.text: Crime — only half of it has a motive

indicators.note: only half of keeps one of the two letters of it, here the second

parts.note: a reason is a motive for doing something

explanation.surface: A crime only half explained by its motive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Treason, betrayal of one's country, is a serious offence.

clue.text: Beat it!

parts.note: read as slang, an order to go away; and also 'beat a ___' is to withdraw, while beating it once more is to treat it again

explanation.definitionFit: Withdrawal is what 'beat it' urges, and to re-treat is to handle again.
